_meta.description: cluster_id -> metadata. Used by cluster.py to build cluster objects and by fix_packs.py for remediation defaults.

http-header-hardening.title: HTTP Header Hardening
http-header-hardening.description: Your server is missing protective browser headers that prevent clickjacking, XSS, and data injection.

tls-hardening.title: TLS/SSL Hardening
tls-hardening.description: Your TLS/SSL configuration has weaknesses that could allow attackers to intercept or downgrade encrypted connections.

auth-hardening.title: Authentication Hardening
auth-hardening.description: Your authentication system has weaknesses that could allow brute force attacks, session hijacking, or credential theft.

xss-protection.title: Cross-Site Scripting Protection
xss-protection.description: Your application has input/output handling flaws that allow attackers to inject malicious scripts into pages viewed by other users.

injection-prevention.title: Injection Prevention
injection-prevention.description: Your application passes user input into commands, queries, or templates without proper sanitization, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code.

secrets-exposure.title: Secrets Exposure
secrets-exposure.description: API keys, tokens, or credentials have been found in your code, git history, or configuration files.

dependency-updates.title: Dependency Updates
dependency-updates.description: Your project uses packages with known security vulnerabilities that have available fixes.

network-hardening.title: Network Hardening
network-hardening.description: Your server exposes ports or services that may not be necessary and could increase your attack surface.

server-hardening.title: Server Hardening
server-hardening.description: Your server configuration has security weaknesses in SSH, services, or system settings that should be tightened.

dns-email-security.title: DNS & Email Security
dns-email-security.description: Your domain is missing DNS security records (SPF, DMARC, DKIM, DNSSEC) that protect against email spoofing and DNS attacks.

payment-security.title: Payment Security
payment-security.description: Your payment pages have security issues that could expose cardholder data or allow skimming attacks.

exposure-cleanup.title: Sensitive File Exposure
exposure-cleanup.description: Sensitive files or directories (.env, .git, backups, admin panels) are publicly accessible on your server.

cors-hardening.title: CORS Hardening
cors-hardening.description: Your CORS configuration allows cross-origin requests that could lead to data theft from authenticated sessions.

database-hardening.title: Database Hardening
database-hardening.description: Your database has configuration weaknesses like anonymous accounts, remote root access, or missing encryption.

mobile-security.title: Mobile App Security
mobile-security.description: Your mobile application has security issues like hardcoded secrets, exported components, or insecure configurations.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.description: Your system has configurations that do not meet common compliance standards (CIS, PCI DSS, etc.).

reconnaissance.title: Reconnaissance (Informational)
reconnaissance.description: Discovery-phase information about your infrastructure. Not vulnerabilities, but useful context for targeted testing.

other.title: Other Findings
other.description: Findings that don't match a known category. Review individually.
